title: Scaling transformer neural networks for skillful and reliable medium-range weather forecasting
layout_note: four unframed bottom-aligned columns, one per forecasting scheme, growing taller from left to right; the paper's scheme (randomized iterative) is last
grouping: No frames: four columns separated by whitespace, each with a two-line name under it ('Direct forecasting', 'Continuous forecasting', 'Iterative forecasting', 'Randomized iterative forecasting'). All columns share one baseline for their inputs.
shapes_depth: Flat rounded rectangles with a pink fill and a darker red outline, all labelled f_theta; inputs and outputs are bare symbols (X_0, T, X_dt, dt_1, dt_2, X_T); a circular-arrow glyph stands between the second and third network copies in the two iterative columns; thin black arrows.
proposed_highlight: The proposed scheme is placed last and combines the extra input of the continuous column with the unrolled steps of the iterative column; it gets no colour or size of its own.
lesson: Draw competing schemes as identical columns that each add one element to the previous one, ours last, so the difference reads from the drawing alone.
notes: The arXiv first page (v2, Oct 2024) prints no venue, so venue = arXiv and year = arXiv preprint year (2312.03876); the candidate list gives NeurIPS 2024, not confirmed from the PDF. Domain given as scientific-ml in the candidate list; the knowledge base's id for that area is ai4science. Figure 7 (appendix) is the Stormer block architecture; Figure 2 is carded because it draws the forecasting scheme the paper proposes. The crop is a single embedded raster recorded by refs crop.

arrangement.units: four unframed columns side by side, separated by whitespace, names below
arrangement.inputs_as: symbols: the initial state X_0 and, where used, the lead time T or interval dt
arrangement.shared: the network is the same pink f_theta box in every column and every unrolled step

taxonomy.task: medium-range weather forecasting by randomized-interval iterative rollout
taxonomy.note: the figure draws the forecasting scheme, not the transformer: one network f_theta applied directly, conditioned on lead time, or unrolled

insights.structure: Four identical-style columns in a row, each a forecasting scheme, ordered so each adds one idea to the last and the proposed one comes last.
insights.data: Inputs, intermediates and outputs are math symbols only (X_0, X_dt, X_T, T, dt); no weather field is drawn.
insights.emphasis: Position only: the proposed scheme is the rightmost column, the same size and colour as the baselines.
insights.flow: Each column reads bottom to top on short vertical arrows; the lead-time input enters beside the state as a second upward arrow.
insights.avoid: A circular-arrow glyph between boxes stands in for the repeated steps, and the second interval dt_2 enters from empty space with nothing showing it is sampled at random.

core.what: four forecasting schemes as identical bottom-aligned columns of the same f_theta box, the proposed randomized iterative scheme last

relations.form: direct, continuous, iterative and randomized iterative forecasting side by side, sharing the input baseline and the same pink network box
the two iterative columns unroll two steps of f_theta with the intermediate state X_dt between them, then a circular-arrow glyph and a final step
the lead time (T, dt_1, dt_2) enters each network as a second upward arrow beside the state input

channels.colour: one meaning: pink = the single network f_theta
channels.shape: rounded box = network, bare symbol = state or time input, circular-arrow glyph = repeat
channels.line: one style: thin black arrow = data flow

quality.strengths: The comparison is the figure's geometry: identical columns side by side with the proposed one last, as derive.md's alternatives form asks; each column adds one element to its neighbour (a time input, then unrolled steps, then both), so the difference is visible with the names covered; one colour and one line style each with one meaning; all arrows are short and vertical; the intermediate state X_dt is drawn between steps.
quality.weaknesses: The proposed column has no salience beyond position; the circular-arrow glyph replaces the repeated steps instead of drawing a third step; the randomization is only in subscripts (dt_1, dt_2), with the second interval arriving from empty space; nothing of the weather data is drawn; the staircase of column heights leaves the top-left third of the figure empty.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
